title: Future Simple Tense with Will
prompt: Create sentences using 'will' to express future actions or decisions.
hint: Use the subject + will + base verb to talk about future actions or sudden decisions.
sample: I will close the window because I'm cold.

ja.prompt: 未来の行動や決定を表すために「will」を使って文を作りましょう。
ja.hint: 主語 + will + 動詞の原形 の形で未来の行動や突然の決定を表します。
ja.sample: 寒いので窓を閉めます。

local.prompt: Create sentences using 'will' to express future actions or decisions.
local.hint: Use the subject + will + base verb to talk about future actions or sudden decisions.
local.sample: I will close the window because I'm cold.

zh.prompt: 使用「will」造句，表達未來的行動或決定。
zh.hint: 使用主詞 + will + 動詞原形來談論未來的行動或突然的決定。

en.prompt: Create sentences using 'will' to express future actions or decisions.
en.hint: Use the subject + will + base verb to talk about future actions or sudden decisions.
en.sample: I will close the window because I'm cold.

title: Future Simple Tense with Be Going To
prompt: Make sentences using 'be going to' to express planned future actions.
hint: Use the subject + be verb + going to + base verb to talk about planned future actions.
sample: I'm going to buy some milk because there is none.

ja.prompt: 予定された未来の行動を表すために「be going to」を使って文を作りましょう。
ja.hint: 主語 + be動詞 + going to + 動詞の原形 の形で予定された未来の行動を表します。
ja.sample: 牛乳がないので買うつもりです。

local.prompt: Make sentences using 'be going to' to express planned future actions.
local.hint: Use the subject + be verb + going to + base verb to talk about planned future actions.
local.sample: I'm going to buy some milk because there is none.

zh.prompt: 使用「be going to」造句，表達計劃中的未來行動。
zh.hint: 使用主詞 + be動詞 + going to + 動詞原形來談論計劃中的未來行動。
zh.sample: 因為沒有牛奶，我打算去買一些。

en.prompt: Make sentences using 'be going to' to express planned future actions.
en.hint: Use the subject + be verb + going to + base verb to talk about planned future actions.
en.sample: I'm going to buy some milk because there is none.

title: Negative Form of Future Simple Tense
prompt: Form negative sentences using 'will not' or 'won't' and 'be going to' with 'not'.
hint: Use subject + will not (won't) + base verb or subject + be verb + not + going to + base verb.
sample: Stan will not like his English score.

ja.prompt: 「will not」や「won't」、および「be going to」の否定形を使って文を作りましょう。
ja.hint: 主語 + will not (won't) + 動詞の原形 または 主語 + be動詞 + not + going to + 動詞の原形 の形を使います。
ja.sample: スタンは自分の英語の点数を気に入らないでしょう。

local.prompt: Form negative sentences using 'will not' or 'won't' and 'be going to' with 'not'.
local.hint: Use subject + will not (won't) + base verb or subject + be verb + not + going to + base verb.
local.sample: Stan will not like his English score.

zh.prompt: 使用「will not」或「won't」以及「be going to」加「not」造否定句。
zh.hint: 使用主詞 + will not (won't) + 動詞原形 或 主詞 + be動詞 + not + going to + 動詞原形。
zh.sample: Stan 不會喜歡他的英文成績。

en.prompt: Form negative sentences using 'will not' or 'won't' and 'be going to' with 'not'.
en.hint: Use subject + will not (won't) + base verb or subject + be verb + not + going to + base verb.
en.sample: Stan will not like his English score.

title: Forming Questions in Future Simple Tense
prompt: Make questions using 'will' or 'be going to' in the future simple tense.
hint: Invert the subject and 'will' or the correct form of 'be' verb + going to + base verb.
sample: Will he play with us? / Is he going to play with us?

ja.prompt: 未来形の疑問文を「will」や「be going to」を使って作りましょう。
ja.hint: 主語と「will」または適切なbe動詞 + going to + 動詞の原形の順序を入れ替えます。
ja.sample: 彼は私たちと遊びますか？

local.prompt: Make questions using 'will' or 'be going to' in the future simple tense.
local.hint: Invert the subject and 'will' or the correct form of 'be' verb + going to + base verb.
local.sample: Will he play with us? / Is he going to play with us?

zh.prompt: 使用「will」或「be going to」造未來簡單式疑問句。
zh.hint: 將主詞與「will」或適當的be動詞 + going to + 動詞原形顛倒順序。

en.prompt: Make questions using 'will' or 'be going to' in the future simple tense.
en.hint: Invert the subject and 'will' or the correct form of 'be' verb + going to + base verb.
en.sample: Will he play with us? / Is he going to play with us?

title: WH Questions in Future Simple Tense
prompt: Create WH questions using 'will' or 'be going to' to ask about future actions.
hint: Start with a WH word, then 'will' or the correct be verb + going to + base verb.
sample: When will they arrive? / Where is he going to study?

ja.prompt: 未来の行動について尋ねるWH疑問文を「will」や「be going to」を使って作りましょう。
ja.hint: WH疑問詞の後に「will」または適切なbe動詞 + going to + 動詞の原形を続けます。
ja.sample: 彼らはいつ到着しますか？ / 彼はどこで勉強するつもりですか？

local.prompt: Create WH questions using 'will' or 'be going to' to ask about future actions.
local.hint: Start with a WH word, then 'will' or the correct be verb + going to + base verb.
local.sample: When will they arrive? / Where is he going to study?

zh.prompt: 使用「will」或「be going to」造WH疑問句，詢問未來行動。
zh.hint: 以WH疑問詞開頭，接著是「will」或適當的be動詞 + going to + 動詞原形。
zh.sample: 他們什麼時候到？ / 他打算在哪裡學習？

en.prompt: Create WH questions using 'will' or 'be going to' to ask about future actions.
en.hint: Start with a WH word, then 'will' or the correct be verb + going to + base verb.
en.sample: When will they arrive? / Where is he going to study?
